title: Vertex Charity Drive 2027
resources: Sponsor-provided prizes, registration desk and photography team

claims.claim_text: We expect approximately 100 attendees for this Charity Drive, in line with turnout at our previous Charity Drive events.
We can deliver this Charity Drive efficiently within INR 6,000, well below typical costs.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will become a flagship tradition for the university.
